analyzed_vuln.description: Heap OOB read occurs in `blosc_d` when decoding per-stream compressed sizes: it calls `cbytes = sw32_(src)` (line ~1349) without validating that `src` still points within the actual chunk buffer. `srcsize` is tracked from metadata (`chunk_cbytes`) and can be inconsistent with real backing memory for malformed frame chunks, so the `srcsize < 4` guard is bypassed and `sw32_` reads past the end of the fuzzer input allocation.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In `decompress_frame_fuzzer`, attacker-controlled bytes are parsed via `blosc2_schunk_from_buffer` into an in-memory frame, then `blosc2_schunk_decompress_chunk` -> `frame_decompress_chunk` passes a chunk pointer/size into `blosc2_decompress_ctx`/`blosc_d`. A crafted frame/chunk with inconsistent internal size/offset metadata causes `blosc_d` to trust logical `srcsize` and attempt to read a 4-byte stream length from `src` beyond the actual input buffer, triggering ASan at `sw32_`.
